# One required long-document pilot: retained early hold

**The pilot failed before a document existed.** It is evidence about the current
pipeline, not a long-artifact witness, independent document acceptance or UI entry.
[Receipt](receipt.json), [prospective protocol](protocol.json), [exact study](study.json),
[preparation](prepared.json), [actual capture receipt](capture-receipt.json).

## Frozen and executed

Clean source 065636c and the trimpath darwin/arm64 executable, exact 48-file manifest,
corpus/goal scope, lanes/settings/prices, rubric, stop rules and one-cell execution
roster were frozen before credentials or dispatch. Pre-dispatch thread th-c5e476b3
records final hashes. The full runner universe is 36 cells; this pilot executed
only technical-design-technical-r1, with 35 unexecuted cells and 43 unexecuted negatives.
No retry, repair, alternate root or fallback occurred. Prior v1 failure remains failed.

The initial private driver had a cancellation gap found before any provider call.
A controlled red exited 130. Flag-only signals, child cleanup/reaping and terminal
receipt finalization replaced the gap; six deterministic fake-child tests passed.
The independent re-review found no blocker. Child environment is allowlisted.
End-to-end signal finalization was source-reviewed, not experimentally qualified.
Superseded pre-dispatch files and both logs remain private.

## What the blind review found

The independent agent reviewed the [unaccepted first node](unaccepted-first-node.json)
and fixed facts/rubric before seeing native support verdicts. The owner separately
checked the source. Both identified these [development regressions](regressions.json):

| Ref | Observation | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| LP-F1 | Native review rejected assertion8's narrow-goal framing; blind agent and owner support its scoped meaning | Reviewer disagreement/false-hold lead; not population accuracy or authenticated human truth |
| LP-F2 | Assertion9 claims nothing in the document describes enacted behavior, despite the same node describing the observed receiver | Material unaccepted draft overclaim; native reviewer never reached it |
| LP-F3 | Only marker and held receipt exist; no version, Markdown or goal sidecar | Actual key-free document-review-prepare refuses, exit2 and empty stdout, without changing artifacts |

All six required first-section facts are represented in the draft, and the blind
agent found it clear for the technical audience. Those observations do not assess
the absent four sections, required 1200..1600-word document, whole-document goals,
source truth or human acceptance. The partial draft is retained evidence, never a
completed node/document or a substitute four-artifact review packet.

## Decision and remaining work

Do not weaken the hold or spend on the full matrix. Scope generation and calibrate
review together under [HP-15](../../../designs/prose-review-scope-calibration.md),
with the entire old control floor and contrasting new cases. 0045/DA failure/review
triggers fired; the required long witness and actual independent goals stay open.
No prospective protocol here authorizes another call in this failed pilot.

HP-14 remains in progress. Full 36-cell generation/repair/negative execution,
selection/group/edit/HITL contracts and HP-A14/18/UI entry remain unproven. The
broader governed-command objective remains active. Library roots and dependencies
are unchanged; no new consumer/runtime/platform adoption is asserted.

The evidence/design change passed `task validate` and strict plan verification.
No new completion box was checked. Actual native reconciliation and the held-receipt
CUE check are separate from static plan proof.
